browserValidationEvidence: Verified July 20, 2026 with Playwright 1.61.0: tests.unit.test_quality passed 44/44 under Chromium 149.0.7827.55, WebKit 26.5, and Firefox 151.0; refreshed July 21, 2026, the full repository suite passed 243/243 under Chromium.

repairGate.reason: Browser coverage is verified, but no capability has explicit automatic-repair eligibility and Repair Coordination remains intentionally disabled.

capabilities.falsePositiveBoundary: Icon-only classification depends on explicit UI-IR role/kind/iconOnly facts.
Only explicit control tags/roles and accessible-name facts are inspected.
Checks canonical UI-IR IDs/keys; dynamically created targets require runtime evidence.
Requires explicit tab role and canonical controlled tabpanel target.
Checks alt presence only; decorative intent and text quality are not inferred.
No spacing-consistency detector is implemented in the inspect-only prototype.
Spacing, inline-target, equivalent-control, and user-agent exceptions are not fully modeled.
Intentional off-canvas and scroll layouts require review.
Image, gradient, blend, opacity, truncated background chain, and unparsed colors are skipped.
Only target, pseudo-elements, two ancestors, and bounded direct children are compared; no pixel diff.
Managed composite descendants are skipped pending arrow-key behavior evidence.
Flags local positive tabindex risk without reconstructing full visual/DOM focus order.
Bounded horizontal scroll containers and semantic table/pre/carousel exceptions are skipped.
Validates only aria-expanded, aria-selected, and aria-pressed token grammar.
Initial sampled state only; missing or truncated controlled targets are skipped.
Condition-free explicit click actions only; no assertions, animations, keyboard actions, or arbitrary state inference.
